tickets.summary: PSV-9001 passed at the outlet seat below set pressure on an isolated synthetic bench; lifting and capacity remain untested, so protective performance is unknown.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect the seat, repair as indicated, then have a valve engineer verify seat tightness, lift and capacity to approved criteria. Obtain valve engineer acceptance criteria. Test lift and capacity to criteria.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Observed below-set seat passing is an active degradation; the synthetic experiment convention assigns likelihood 6, while lifting and capacity remain untested.

impact_of_failure.rationale: The device is an isolated evaluation fixture, not installed plant, so failure has only a limited test-fixture consequence and no evidenced operating exposure.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v2: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=6, I=1, base=3, final=3.
